premium.paywall.headline: Your life is passing. Start watching it.
premium.paywall.subheadline: See every day, month, and year of your life. Live on your home screen and overlay.
premium.paywall.onboardingSub: Month, life, and overlay stay with you so the plan you just built doesn’t disappear.
premium.paywall.freeForever: Day & year widgets and Share stay free forever.
premium.paywall.lifeUnlockEndedMessage: Your 24-hour Life preview ended. Premium keeps your life %, month widget, and overlay on every day.
premium.preview.activeRest: No payment or subscription yet. When the preview ends, Premium locks unless you subscribe. You will not be charged automatically.
premium.preview.noChargeNote: No payment is taken during the free app preview. You are only charged if you choose to subscribe.
premium.preview.cancelNote: To cancel an active subscription, manage it in your app store account.
premium.preview.endingToday: Your free app preview ends today. You will not be charged unless you subscribe. To keep Premium, subscribe at {{price}}/year. Cancel any subscription in {{path}}.
premium.preview.endingTomorrow: Your free app preview ends tomorrow. No automatic charge. Subscribe at {{price}}/year to keep month & life widgets. Cancel in {{path}}.
premium.preview.daysLeft_one: {{count}} day left in your free app preview. No payment during the preview. Subscribe at {{price}}/year when ready. Cancel anytime in {{path}}.
premium.preview.daysLeft_other: {{count}} days left in your free app preview. No payment during the preview. Subscribe at {{price}}/year when ready. Cancel anytime in {{path}}.
premium.loss.headlineFallback: Your life is passing whether you watch it or not.
premium.loss.headlineWithLife: You’ve lived {{pct}}% of your life, and it’s still rising off-screen.
premium.loss.month: Each month passes unseen. No month widget.
premium.loss.life: Your life % climbs invisibly. No Life screen.
premium.loss.hours: Lost hours vanish with no red alert
premium.loss.previewFooter_one: Your preview ends in {{count}} day. After that, month & life lock.
premium.loss.previewFooter_other: Your preview ends in {{count}} days. After that, month & life lock.
premium.renewal.week: {{price}} charged today, then {{price}} every week. Renews automatically until you cancel. Cancel anytime in {{path}}, at least 24 hours before renewal.
premium.renewal.month: {{price}} charged today, then {{price}} every month. Renews automatically until you cancel. Cancel anytime in {{path}}, at least 24 hours before renewal.
premium.renewal.year: {{price}} charged today, then {{price}} every year. Renews automatically until you cancel. Cancel anytime in {{path}}, at least 24 hours before renewal.
premium.manage.path: Settings › Manage subscription, or your app store account
premium.student.title: Verify student email
premium.student.body: Enter a school email to unlock the student yearly price. Same Premium features. Soft check only (no document upload).
premium.student.error.underAge: Student pricing needs you to be {{age}} or older.
premium.tiles.heading: What you keep with Premium
premium.tiles.life.label: Life view
premium.tiles.life.blurb: Full life % and weeks. Always visible.
premium.tiles.month.label: Month widget
premium.tiles.month.blurb: See the month pass on your home screen.
premium.tiles.overlay.label: Overlay
premium.tiles.overlay.blurb: Month & life float above other apps.
premium.tiles.alerts.label: Lost-time alerts
premium.tiles.alerts.blurb: A nudge when wasted hours cross your limit.
premium.disclosure.preview: {{days}}-day free app preview (in-app only, not a store subscription trial). No payment is required during the preview.
premium.disclosure.previewEndsRest: Premium features lock after that unless you subscribe. You will not be charged automatically when the preview ends.
premium.disclosure.yearly: Yearly subscription: {{price}}/year. Charged when you subscribe. Renews yearly until you cancel at least 24 hours before renewal in {{path}}.
premium.disclosure.monthly: Monthly subscription: {{price}}/month. Billed when you subscribe. Cancel anytime in {{path}}.
premium.disclosure.weekly: Weekly subscription: {{price}}/week. Billed when you subscribe. Cancel anytime in {{path}}.
premium.alert.genericError: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
premium.alert.nothingToRestoreBody: No active purchase found for this account.
premium.alert.manageIos: Open Settings › your name › Subscriptions to cancel.
premium.alert.manageAndroid: Open Google Play › Profile › Payments & subscriptions › Subscriptions to cancel.
premium.tiles.deadlines.label: Every deadline and counter
premium.tiles.deadlines.blurb: Keep up to {{max}} of each, not just one. A widget lists your next three deadlines.
premium.limit.deadlines.title: More deadlines with Premium
premium.limit.deadlines.body: The free plan keeps one deadline. Premium holds up to {{max}}, and your widget always shows the one that is nearest.
premium.limit.counters.title: More counters with Premium
premium.limit.counters.body: The free plan keeps one counter. Premium holds up to {{max}}, and you choose which one your widget shows.
